sources.title: Vision-Language Models for 3D Scene Understanding: Applications and ...
sources.snippet: This article focuses on the applications and advances of Visual Language Modeling (VLM) in 3D scene understanding. The article details several mainstream visual language models and analyzes the application of visual language models to three different downstream tasks including: 3D Question and Answering, 3D Visual Grounding, and 3D Semantic Segmentation.
